scheme_name: Skill Development Training - 90 Days Skill Development Training Programme in Curtain & Garment Stitching
other_conditions: Must be a dependent of a registered construction worker.
Must have completed at least the 5th class.
Must have knowledge of Telugu, Hindi, and English languages.
Must be an unemployed girl, widowed, divorced, or deserted daughter/spouse.
benefits_summary: Participants receive hands‑on training in curtain and garment stitching and are provided a domestic sewing machine upon completion.
